summary_rationale: XLV provides institutional-grade, 0.08%-expense access to 61 profitable S&P 500 healthcare leaders ($46.86B AUM as of Nov 24, 2026, 0.01% median bid-ask spread, -10 bps 5-year tracking difference, +$1.02B 1Y net inflows, and a 5-year dividend growth streak reaching $2.55/share TTM). Its underlying constituents generate ~21.5% look-through FCF margins, anchored by Eli Lilly's $16.08B Q3 2026 Mounjaro/Zepbound surge, AbbVie's Nov 23, 2026 FDA approval of RINVOQ for nonsegmental vitiligo, Intuitive Surgical's >10,000 daily robotic procedures, and Thermo Fisher's bioprocessing recovery. While business quality earns a clear COMPOUNDER_PASS, KPI health remains PASS_WITH_WATCH due to 60.64% top-10 concentration (16.78% in LLY), CMS's Nov 23, 2026 IPAY 2028 finalization bringing IRA Medicare drug-price negotiations to 37 cumulative drugs (including an 84% cut on Trulicity and 37% on Biktarvy, though exempting Botox and Xeljanz), Merck's Dec 2028 Keytruda cliff plus ex-XLV PD-1/VEGF competition from Akeso/Summit's ivonescimab, $100.0B CY2025 340B hospital discount leakage, AbbVie's post-Apogee leverage/contingent-consideration overhang and JNJ's $5.5B proposed talc settlement, elevated Managed Care MCRs (88.4% at UNH), Big-Three wholesaler concentration, and active FTC/DOJ PBM scrutiny.
